headline: Recommended final passage of secondhand dealer and public comment ordinances; recommended indefinite postponement of resolution R-26-049 on homeless services.
summary: Recommended Michael McDowell as a new Arts Commission member and Judith Carlson for re-appointment. Recommended final passage of O-26-012 on secondhand dealers as amended, O-26-018 on public comment time limits, and O-26-021 as amended on first-period public comment time. Recommended indefinite postponement of R-26-049 after the motion for its final passage failed.
decisions: Accepted and placed on file a communication from Deputy Corporation Counsel Dorothy Clarke explaining the ADA process statement in the analysis of O-26-002.
Recommended new appointment of Michael McDowell to the Arts Commission, term to expire June 9, 2029; vote 5-0.
Removed from the table the appointment of Judith Carlson to the Arts Commission; vote 4-1.
Recommended re-appointment of Judith Carlson to the Arts Commission, term to expire April 1, 2029; vote 3-2.
Approved Alderman Sennott's amendment to O-26-012 on secondhand dealers, which adds a fifteen-day possession requirement; vote 5-0.
Recommended final passage of O-26-012 as amended, amending the definition of secondhand dealers; vote 5-0.
Motion to recommend final passage of resolution R-26-049, establishing a Homeless Services Gap Analysis Committee, failed; vote 2-3.
Recommended indefinite postponement of resolution R-26-049 on the Homeless Services Gap Analysis Committee; vote 3-2.
Recommended final passage of O-26-018, removing the total time limit for public comment periods during committee meetings; vote 5-0.
Approved an amendment to O-26-021 raising public comment time during the first public comment period to four minutes; vote 4-1.
Recommended final passage of O-26-021 as amended, increasing individual public comment time during the first public comment period; vote 3-2.
Motion to remove O-26-002, allowing electronic public comment for people with walking disabilities, from the table failed; vote 2-3.
Motion by Alderman Clemons to remove O-26-002 from the table failed; vote 2-3.
Carried a motion to remove O-26-002 from the table at the next meeting; vote 5-0.
